product_metadata.title: CHULUX Stainless Steel Single Serve Coffee Maker for Capsule,Visiable Gradient Water Reservoir,One Button Operation and Auto Shut Off,1000 Watts
features: 【SINGLE CUP COFFEE POD DESIGN】Brew with coffee capsule or ground coffee(NOT included reusable filter).With Stainless Steel Housing,our coffee brewer is perfect for home,office,hotel,apartment,dormroom and caravan,so you never worry without hot coffee.Only be used for 120V voltage.

【QUICK BREW + AUTO SHUT OFF SYSTEM】Simple one button with blue indicator light,1000W fast heating element make coffee is consistently flavorful, full-bodied and smooth,just enjoy great-tasting coffee in 2-3 mins.You also can stop brewing by pressing button.

【LARGE MOUTH RESERVOIR WITH GRADIENT SCALE】Turn right to lock filter basket,water can be stay at upper reservoir when add,4-10oz amount to be controlled easily (Pls do not add water over max).After close lid,water will flow into internal tank through filter which can advoid powder or dust,ensure fresh coffee for each cup.

【CONCEALED NEEDLE + FOOD-APPROVED MATERIAL】BPA-free for water tank and piercing tips.The needle will be hidden when open lid which ensure safety.The upper and inside needles extract coffee flavor.There is no wasted coffee since you’re brewing one portion at a time.

【HASSLE-FREE CLEANING】After finish brewing,just take out capsule.For regular cleaning,press button and brew 2-3 cycles with water and vinegar to clean coffee machine. Removable drip tray collects drips to keep brew space clean.
